verdict.rationale: The docs describe a stagewise Account as 'the fastest way to start', giving access to pre-configured models through a managed inference service with 'No API keys needed'. The pricing page lists a free Hobby tier with limited access to 3 standard models (Default, Quick, Smart), and providers can be routed through the account rather than BYOK. Community reports describe onboarding friction: a sign-in email that never arrived, no visible account-creation path, and sign-up only via CLI. These are hands-on failures but point to a rough flow rather than an absent capability, so they lower confidence instead of creating a dispute. Missing for 10: free tier is limited to only 3 models, independent confirmation that sign-in and free-tier access work smoothly, documented free-tier usage limits.
